tasks.title: Init script for three roles, passwords from env, compose and env example
tasks.done_when: On a fresh volume, psql shows lawbyai_owner, lawbyai_app, lawbyai_auth in pg_roles with rolsuper=false for all and rolbypassrls=true only for lawbyai_auth; lawbyai_auth has NOLOGIN, owner has CREATE,USAGE on public, and pg_auth_members shows lawbyai_auth granted to lawbyai_owner with inherit_option=false and set_option=true

tasks.title: Owner URL in settings, env.py, compose init and test services; initialize() only checks head
tasks.done_when: .venv/bin/pytest tests/unit -k 'settings or initialize_head' passes: owner URL is read from env, initialize() raises a clear error on a DB not at head and does not run upgrade; compose init and test services run alembic upgrade head with the owner URL

tasks.title: Migration part 1: role and owner checks, NO FORCE window, tenant-only policies
tasks.done_when: alembic upgrade head with the owner URL on a fresh volume succeeds; with a missing role it stops and names the role; as lawbyai_app with no tenant set, SELECT count(*) FROM users and FROM tenants return 0; relforcerowsecurity is true for tenants and users at head; SET LOCAL lock_timeout='5s' is in the revision

tasks.title: Migration part 2: auth_lookup_user function, grants, default privileges, downgrade
tasks.done_when: After upgrade, pg_proc shows prosecdef=true, proconfig has search_path=pg_catalog, pg_temp, proowner=lawbyai_auth, has_function_privilege('public','public.auth_lookup_user(text)','EXECUTE')=false; alembic downgrade -1 then upgrade head succeeds, the function is gone after downgrade, the old policies are restored and ck_users_email_normalised remains

tasks.title: Docs SQL for old volumes (roles, ownership changes, grants)
